images.alt: A dense cluster of ruffled, crocheted coral-like forms in bright red, their frilled edges trimmed in yellow, turquoise, green and pink.
A low, boat-shaped vessel with a rough rust-orange base and a rippling, cupped rim glazed in green and cream.
A tall, rounded, dark mottled form rising from a wide craggy bowl, its surface flecked with rust, purple and brown.
A pale clay sculpture of jagged upright spires streaked with brown, rising from a smooth curved base on a workshop table.
A tall ridged form in mottled brown and cream, split by a long opening down one side.
A pale yellow glazed sculpture with two pointed ear-like tips above a bulbous body, seated in a ring of open petal shapes.
A green and pink glazed vessel topped with a flared trumpet-like opening, a dark hollow cut into its lower side.
A tall rust-orange glazed jar crowned with a ragged collar of upturned petal shapes.
A smooth pale cream ovoid form trailing a long tapering green-mottled tail that curves away to the left.
An undulating orange crocheted form with deeply rippled frilled edges picked out in pink, green and blue.
A black crocheted form folded into regular deep waves, flecked here and there with purple, yellow and blue.
An upright open structure built from thin pale branching twigs, standing against a grey ground.
A long horizontal lattice of pale sticks lashed at the joints, enclosing a small skull at its left end.
A standing assemblage of pale bones and branch-like limbs supporting a pink skull, photographed on a parquet floor.
A narrow vertical image of a receding row of pale yellow-green skulls fading into darkness.
A painting of five standing figures showing skeletal, muscular and nervous-system layers against a dark red-brown ground.
A painting of a radiating white burst held inside concentric rings, surrounded by swirling pink, red and grey.
A soft-focus image of a pale dog lying on its side draped in cloth, in a dim interior.
A dark blurred image of a black form standing over a small pale spill on a pink-grey surface.
A vertical painting of a jagged white and grey peak at the centre of a dark swirling purple vortex.
A vertical painting of turbulent red, black and white strokes gathered around a dark circular void.
A painting of sweeping black brushstrokes driven across blocks of red, green and yellow.
A painting of a dark scribbled mass hanging above a row of small pale squares on a washed grey ground.
A drawing on graph paper: a dense knot of black gestural marks near the top, with a few isolated strokes far below.
A drawing on graph paper of slashing black strokes laid over a scattered grid of filled grey and black squares.
A pencil drawing of a recessed rectangular niche framing a tall column of tiny coloured squares.
A drawing split down the middle: a dense field of small pale coloured squares on the left, fine grey hatching on the right.
A pencil drawing of a dark arc sweeping over a pale field, crossed by a red-brown bar above three small triangles.
A close view of a pencil drawing: grey hatching, a red horizontal line and faint ruled squares.
A dark, heavily blurred image of a seated figure marked by two small points of red at the chest.
A charcoal drawing of a reclining figure dissolving into dense dark scribbled strokes.
A horizontal charcoal drawing of layered wavy strands filling the sheet like matted fibre.
A charcoal drawing of a seated figure seen from behind, built up in dense dark strokes.
A charcoal drawing of two dark rounded masses side by side, made from tangled scribbled lines.
